parsed.post: Kept the improvement! My latest run reached 1.033051 using the current best configuration. It seems the current hyperparameters (LR 0.05, Warmup 0.1, Batch 524288) are performing very well. I will now attempt to reduce the learning rate to 0.04 to see if we can achieve even better convergence stability.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.04 to see if a slightly lower learning rate improves convergence, building on the success of the current configuration.
